Auth.title: Sign in
Auth.subtitle: Open your hotel workspace and manage the day.
Auth.heroBody: Rooms, bookings and housekeeping in one place.
Auth.usernameInvalid: Use 3–32 English letters or numbers. Dots and dashes are also allowed.
Auth.sessionSaved: You’ll stay signed in on this device until you log out.
Auth.help: Managers create staff accounts in Settings. Contact your manager if you do not have your login details.
Auth.invalidOwner: The email address or password is incorrect. Try again.
Auth.invalidStaff: The username or password is incorrect. Check the details provided by the owner.
Auth.unconfirmed: This account still needs email confirmation.
Auth.hotelCodeHint: Your manager gives you this. It is saved on this device, so you will not need to type it again.
Auth.hotelInvalid: A hotel code is lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
Auth.otherHotel: I work at a different hotel
Auth.resetNeedsEmail: Enter your email address first, then choose “Forgotten your password”.
Auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a link to set a new password has been sent to it. The link lasts an hour, and may land in the spam folder.

Shell.noHotel: This account is not linked to a hotel
Shell.noHotelBody: The account works, but it has not been granted access to a hotel yet. Ask a manager to add it from Settings.
Shell.forbidden: This page is not available to your role ({role}).
Shell.offline: No connection — showing the latest saved copy.
Shell.pending: {count, number} actions are waiting to be sent.

Dashboard.title: Today overview
Dashboard.roomHint: Select a room to view details and actions.

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.subtitle: Rooms are rows, days are columns. Select a free night to book it, or a stay to see its details.
Calendar.newBookingHere: Book this room from this date
Calendar.summary: {occupied, number} of {total, number} rooms occupied on {date}

Confirmation.title: Booking confirmation message
Confirmation.copyFailed: Copying failed — select the text and copy it manually
Confirmation.noPhone: This guest has no phone number saved. Add one to the booking first.

Guests.title: Guest records
Guests.subtitle: Hotels in Egypt must record who stayed. Fill this in at check-in while the passport is in hand, and export the period whenever it is asked for.
Guests.exportHint: The file opens straight in Excel, and exports exactly what the current filters show.
Guests.incomplete: {count, number} guests have details missing or worth checking in this period.
Guests.search: Search by name, reference or ID number…
Guests.name: Full name as written on the ID
Guests.noHistory: No stays recorded for this guest.
Guests.carryOnAnyway: You can carry on either way.

Charges.title: Extras
Charges.voided: Line voided and the bill adjusted
Charges.voidNote: The line is not deleted — it is marked void and drops out of the bill. Taking money off a bill needs the manager password.
Charges.needsNetwork: Extras need a connection — the bill is calculated in the database, not on the phone.
Charges.needQuantity: Quantity must be greater than zero
Charges.settingsNote: These prices fill themselves in when reception picks the item, and can still be changed for one guest.
Charges.noItems: No items yet. Add the first one so reception finds it ready.

Seasons.note: A season overrides the standing price for its dates only. Pricing is night by night, so a stay crossing a season boundary is charged correctly on each side.
Seasons.name: Season name
Seasons.emptyMeansStanding: An empty box means this combination falls back to the standing price during this season.
Seasons.saved: {count, number} prices saved for the season
Seasons.deleted: Season deleted; prices fall back to standing
Seasons.confirmSaveNote: These prices apply to every new booking in this period. Bookings already taken do not change.
Seasons.confirmDeleteNote: The season's prices are removed and the period returns to the standing price. Bookings already taken keep what they were quoted.
Seasons.needDates: Set the season's start and end
Seasons.badDates: The season must end after it starts

Setup.title: Before you go live
Setup.blockingNote: {count, number} things stand between this and real use.
Setup.advisoryNote: The app is ready to work; these finish it off.
Setup.disappears: This list disappears on its own once every item is done.

rates.title: Real rates
rates.why: Not one rate is above zero, so a new booking prices at nothing. A box saved as zero is not a box filled in.

roomTypes.title: Real room types
roomTypes.why: Every room is still “standard room”, and the price depends on the type.

managerPassword.title: Manager password
managerPassword.why: Without it, cancelling, taking a line off a bill and changing rates all pass unchallenged.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp number
whatsapp.why: The booking confirmation is sent from it.

policy.title: Cancellation policy
policy.why: It appears in the confirmation the guest receives.

staff.title: Staff accounts
staff.why: Only the owner's account exists; reception needs its own.

Provisional.title: Provisional bookings
Provisional.leadPending: {count, plural, one {# booking was taken with no connection and has not arrived yet — the room is not held until it does.} other {# bookings were taken with no connection and have not arrived yet — the rooms are not held until they do.}}
Provisional.leadFailed: {count, plural, one {# provisional booking was refused and needs attention.} other {# provisional bookings were refused and need attention.}}
Provisional.leadSent: {count, plural, one {# provisional booking was confirmed.} other {# provisional bookings were confirmed.}}
Provisional.offlineNotice: No connection. This will be recorded provisionally, and the room is not actually held until the connection returns — tell the guest their confirmation follows shortly.
Provisional.recorded: Recorded provisionally for {name}. It will be sent as soon as the connection returns.
Provisional.noPrice: The price is worked out when the booking arrives, because the rates live in the database.
Provisional.availabilityUnknown: These rooms come from the latest copy saved on this device, so availability is not certain.
Provisional.heldByCache: Occupied as of the last update
Provisional.conflictsDraft: Clashes with another provisional booking on this device
Provisional.reasonTaken: The room went to another guest before the connection returned. Call the guest and pick another room.
Provisional.reasonUnauthorised: This account is not allowed to take bookings at this hotel.
Provisional.reasonNoRatePlan: There is no default booking channel in Settings.
Provisional.stay: {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} · {rooms} · {heads, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}
Provisional.noSavedRooms: There is no saved copy of the rooms on this device. Open the app once with a connection, and after that bookings can be recorded offline.
Provisional.duplicates: {count, plural, one {There is one other record on this number} other {There are # other records on this number}}. The one with the longest history was chosen, and new bookings will stop adding more.

Queue.title: An action is stuck
Queue.lead: This action was not accepted, and everything else recorded offline is waiting behind it — the order is kept so a check-out cannot overtake a check-in. Deal with it or delete it so the rest can go through.
Queue.permanent: Trying again will not help — something about the booking changed since this was recorded.
Queue.discardNote: Deleting only removes it from the queue. If it still needs doing, do it from its own screen.

Checkout.earlyBody: The booking runs to {date}. How should the nights they did not stay be billed?
Checkout.earlyNote: Either way the room-nights are recorded as the guest actually slept them, so occupancy and average rate stay honest. Billing the whole booking adds the difference as an early-departure line, which a manager can take off later with their password.

Reset.title: A new password
Reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account, then sign in with it.
Reset.heroBody: One step and you are back in the hotel's screens.
Reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Reset.done: Your password has been changed. Taking you back to sign in so you can use it.
Reset.linkExpired: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one from the sign-in screen.
Reset.staffNote: This page is for the owner's account. Staff passwords are reset from Settings → Staff.

Export.note: Opens in Excel as a formatted table: a row per night, with a total at the end.

Backup.title: Backup
Backup.never: No backup has ever been taken. The hotel has no copy right now.
Backup.today: The last backup was taken today.
Backup.lastTaken: {days, plural, one {The last backup was taken yesterday.} other {The last backup was taken # days ago.}}
Backup.what: One file with everything: rooms, types, rates, seasons, guests, bookings, nights, payments, extras, and staff accounts with their roles. It carries no passwords.
Backup.where: Keep the file in two places — your device and your email, say. A file on one device is not a backup.
Backup.notAReplacement: This is a copy you take yourself, so it is only as good as your habit. Automatic daily backups come with upgrading Supabase to Pro, and those are what cover the mistakes you find out about late.
Backup.notBackup: What came back is not a valid backup. Nothing was saved.
Backup.empty: The backup came back with no rooms in it. It was not saved, so you are not left thinking you are covered.

Bill.title: Statement of account
Bill.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it

Paste.title: Read a message
Paste.intro: Paste the guest's message here and we will read the dates, the name and the number out of it. Check what we read before carrying on.
Paste.placeholder: Hi, do you have a double room from 20 to 23 August for 2 people?…
Paste.nothingFound: No date and no number in this message. Fill the form in by hand.
Paste.checkIt: Anything marked in yellow is a guess — check it before confirming. What is not in the message you fill in yourself.
Paste.filled: Filled in what we read from the message
Paste.name: Name
Paste.asked: The message asked{rooms, plural, =0 {} one { for one room} other { for # rooms}}{pax, plural, =0 {} one { for one guest} other { for # guests}}.

Board.attention: {count, plural, one {One booking needs attention} other {# bookings need attention}}
Board.staleNote: This is saved data, not live data.
Board.queued: Saved — it will be sent as soon as the connection is back
Board.roomStatusNote: Select a room to view details and available actions.
Board.extendOffline: Extending needs a connection — the room must be known to be free before it is promised to the guest.
Board.blockedHint: To extend, move the guest to another room — the “Move to another room” button below.
Board.freeUntil: The room is free through this date.
Board.checkedOut: Checked out, and the room is on the cleaning list
Board.returnedToService: The room is back in service
Board.moveHint: Choosing a date after the stay began leaves the earlier nights on the current room and puts the rest on the new one.
Board.noneFit: No free room takes {count, plural, one {one guest} other {# guests}} on these dates.
Board.differentType: — a different type, so the rate may change
Board.moved: Guest moved and the bill adjusted
Board.blockOpen: Take the room out of service
Board.blockTitle: Take the room out of service
Board.blocked: The room is out of service
Board.blockedWithMoves: The room is out of service. {count, plural, one {One booking needs moving} other {# bookings need moving}} — see the notice above.

NewBooking.title: New booking
NewBooking.intro: Start with the phone number — a guest who has stayed here before comes up on their own.
NewBooking.lookupFailed: The guest lookup failed. Try again before recording the booking.
NewBooking.returning: Returning guest — {count, plural, one {one stay} other {# stays}}, the last on {date}.
NewBooking.noShows: This guest has failed to turn up {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} before.
NewBooking.owes: {amount} {currency} still owed from an earlier stay.
NewBooking.badDates: The departure must be after the arrival
NewBooking.pickRooms: Select a room, then set how many people are in it.
NewBooking.noneFree: No rooms are free on these dates.
NewBooking.summary: {rooms, plural, one {one room} other {# rooms}} · {heads, plural, one {one guest} other {# guests}} · {nights, plural, one {one night} other {# nights}}
NewBooking.unpriced: The price could not be worked out — check the connection. Do not confirm a booking whose price is not showing.
NewBooking.zeroPrice: The price is zero — this combination has no rate in Settings yet.
NewBooking.justTaken: The room was booked moments ago. Refresh and choose another.
NewBooking.phoneHasOthers: This number is already on {count, plural, one {one other guest} other {# other guests}} ({names}).
NewBooking.willBeNewGuest: The booking will be recorded under “{name}” on the same number.

Activity.title: Activity log
Activity.subtitle: A complete, time-ordered record of hotel operations.
Activity.forbiddenBody: Operational history contains staff and financial details.
Activity.searchPlaceholder: Search by guest, employee, booking or room

Bookings.title: Bookings
Bookings.subtitle: Search by name, phone number or reference.
Bookings.stayLine: {nights, plural, one {one night} other {# nights}} · {pax, plural, one {one guest} other {# guests}}
Bookings.paymentsNeedConnection: Recording a payment needs a connection, so two devices cannot disagree about the balance.
Bookings.isRefund: This is a refund to the guest
Bookings.paymentsNeverDeleted: Payments are never deleted. A mistake is corrected with a refund, so the record stays complete.
Bookings.releaseNote: The other rooms on the booking stay as they are, and the bill adjusts itself.
Bookings.released: The room was taken off the booking
Bookings.closed: This booking is closed; there is nothing left to do on it.
Bookings.actionsNeedConnection: Cancelling and amending need a connection, so the room goes back on sale at once.
Bookings.cancelInHouse: The guest is in house. Cancelling empties the room at once — if they are leaving early, use “Early departure” instead.
Bookings.cancelFrees: Rooms ({rooms}) go straight back on sale.
Bookings.cancelled: Booking cancelled and the rooms are free again
Bookings.noShowNote: The rooms go back on sale at once, so tonight can still be sold.
Bookings.earlyNote: The nights they will not stay come off the bill, and the room goes back on sale.
Bookings.earlyPinNote: An early departure reduces the bill, so it needs confirming.
Bookings.shortened: Stay shortened and the bill adjusted
Bookings.earlyReads: Departure becomes {date} — the stay becomes {nights, plural, one {one night} other {# nights}}, and {dropped, plural, one {one night} other {# nights}} come off the bill.

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.note: Revenue is counted per night, so a stay spanning two months is split between them.
Reports.noNights: No nights were sold in this period. Every figure is zero.
Reports.lost: {cancellations, plural, one {One cancellation} other {# cancellations}} and {noShows, plural, one {one no-show} other {# no-shows}} in this period.
Reports.extrasSoldNote: What the hotel sells besides the room.
Reports.byMethodNote: For cashing up at the end of a shift.
Reports.sourceLine: {bookings, plural, one {one booking} other {# bookings}} · {nights, plural, one {one room-night} other {# room-nights}}
Reports.cancellationsNote: Who cancelled what, when, and why.
Reports.discountsNote: Room revenue above is already net of this

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.needTypeFirst: Add a room type first, from the Rooms tab.
Settings.rateHint: The nightly price for the whole room. An empty box means that combination is not for sale.
Settings.ratesSaved: {count, plural, one {One rate saved} other {# rates saved}}
Settings.ratesPinNote: A rate change affects every new booking, so it needs the manager password.
Settings.roomTypesNote: Each type has its own rates. If your rooms are all the same standard, one type is enough — rename it to describe your rooms rather than adding another. “Maximum occupancy” sets the rows of the rate grid.
Settings.name: Name
Settings.needNameAndCode: The name and the code are both required
Settings.typeSummary: {rooms, plural, one {one room} other {# rooms}} · up to {max, plural, one {one guest} other {# guests}}
Settings.staffNote: Each staff member sees only their own work. Housekeeping sees no money and no guest details.
Settings.usernameHint: At least 3 English letters or digits, no spaces. For example: ahmed or reception1
Settings.roleOption_reception: Reception — books, checks in, takes payment
Settings.staffLoginNote: Staff sign in with a username and password only, with no email address. Hand them both yourself.
Settings.needStaffFields: The name and an English username are required, at least 3 characters
Settings.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters
Settings.staffAdded: {name} added. Hand them the username and password.
Settings.resetDescription: Enter at least 8 characters, then hand the password to them securely.
Settings.passwordChanged: The password was changed. Give them the new one.
Settings.pinNote: A password asked for before cancelling, no-shows, early check-out and rate changes.
Settings.pinOn: The password is on. These actions require confirmation.
Settings.pinOff: No password is set. Anyone with permission can cancel without confirming.
Settings.pinForgotten: The password is stored encrypted — neither I nor anyone else can read it, so if you forget it you set a new one here. After 5 wrong tries it locks for a quarter of an hour.
Settings.pinClearBody: Once removed, cancellations and no-shows will not ask for further confirmation.
Settings.englishContentNote: The Arabic name is the original. What you write here is what a foreign guest and a staff member working in English see — in the confirmation message, on the bill, and across the app. An empty box shows the Arabic as it is.
Settings.englishMissing: {count, plural, one {One box} other {# boxes}} not filled in yet, and will show in Arabic to foreign guests.
Settings.englishComplete: Every piece of content has an English version.
Settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP — up to 5MB.
Settings.invalidType: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
Settings.tooLarge: The image must be 5MB or smaller.
Settings.phoneTooShort: That phone number is too short — check it or leave it empty
Settings.usernameFixed: The username “{username}” cannot be changed — it is half of this member's sign-in address, and changing it would lock them out. To change it, create a new account and deactivate this one.
Settings.usernameFixedOwner: The owner signs in with their email address, not a username.

Platform.title: Platform console
Platform.subtitle: Hotels and accounts — for the platform operator alone.
Platform.forbidden: This page is for the platform operator alone.

Platform.openHotelNote: This creates the hotel and its owner's account together. Hand the owner their email and password yourself.
Platform.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed afterwards.
Platform.addressPreview: Staff at this hotel will sign in with addresses like: {address}
Platform.created: {name} is open — hand the owner their details.
Platform.problem_code:short: The branch code is too short (at least 3 characters)
Platform.problem_code:long: The branch code is too long (40 characters at most)
Platform.problem_code:reserved: That branch code is reserved by the platform
Platform.problem_code:taken: That branch code belongs to another hotel
Platform.problem_ownerEmail: The owner's email is not valid
Platform.problem_password: The password must be at least 8 characters

Discount.title: Discount on room {room}
Discount.noteHint: Friend of the owner, long stay…
Discount.appliesToAll: The discount applies to every room selected. You can change it for one room from the booking screen afterwards.
Discount.pricedPerNight: The discount is worked out on each night at that night's own price, so a stay crossing a season is discounted correctly.
Discount.pinNote: A discount lowers the guest's bill, so it asks for the manager password like every other action that touches money.
Discount.cleared: Discount removed, the price is back as it was
Discount.unknownKind: That kind of discount is not recognised
Discount.noDiscount: Zero is no discount — choose “No discount” if that is what you meant

BookingEdit.title: Edit booking
BookingEdit.note: For correcting what was written down: the name, the number, the head count, the notes.
BookingEdit.datesElsewhere: Dates are not edited here: to extend, tap the room on the Today screen; to leave earlier, use “Early departure” below.
BookingEdit.needPax: Every room needs at least one guest
BookingEdit.tooManyPax: That is more guests than the room takes
